M1.model: Proportional-odds cumulative logistic, five common slopes and four ordered cutpoints, no separate free intercept/random effect
M1.estimator: Unweighted maximum likelihood; inverse observed-information covariance

M2.model: Separate Bernoulli logit with fixed intercept/five slopes and independent Gaussian item and originating-actor-within-item intercepts

M3.model: Same nested family fitted separately with distinct coefficients/variances; no cross-outcome covariance estimated

coding.hierarchy: Directed reference -> originating actor/statement, act_id=text_id+'_'+akteur_id -> item text_id. Country/medium are contextual fixed predictors, not random hierarchy levels.
coding.missingness: Saved dictionary reports no missing required main-model fields; code rejects invalid/missing required outcomes/predictors/keys; no imputation or auxiliary-field-based exclusion.
coding.exceptions: Preserve author-selected mediatype/country rather than legacy medientyp/land, documented codebook binary-number conflicts and one reference with both binary outcomes present.

recovered_specification.binary_estimator: Frequentist marginal maximum likelihood, recursive posterior mean/variance adaptive GH7 per random-intercept dimension. BFGS search/refinement and numerical observed information are Python implementation choices.
recovered_specification.uncertainty: Normal 95% Wald intervals; full covariance delta method for probabilities/category contrasts, including binary variance-parameter uncertainty.
recovered_specification.predictions: Change one predictor category in copies of all observed analysis rows and average empirically; discrete category-minus-base probability differences. M1 gives five category probabilities. M2/M3 integrate over prior independent normal random-effect distributions, primary tensor GH7 per intercept; combined GH7 and higher-node calculations are saved numerical comparisons.
recovered_specification.hypotheses: H1a majoritarian positive M1/M2; H1b negative M3. H2a contested positive M1/M2; H2b negative M3. H3a website/newspaper negative M1/M2; H3b positive M3. Mixed-system contrasts are additional comparisons.
recovered_specification.reliability: Original independent ratings, source rater subsets, identity weights, conditional SEs, 95% intervals, probabilistic benchmarking; no reliability recomputation here.

M1.matches: Logit; expected five slopes/four cuts; N=1700; covariance method; original item hash
M1.note: Saved acceptance uses score, positive information and ordered cutpoints rather than optimizer success alone; not revalidated statistically here.

saved_fit_comparison.version_interpretation: M1 retains its historical ordinal implementation version identifier. Semantic model/code comparison and manifest binding pass; identical version labels across engines are not assumed.

hypotheses.recovered_pattern: Professional media: lower outrage/higher recognition. Political-system predictions lack consistent support. Division: higher item outrage and higher reference recognition (recognition opposite prediction); reference outrage unsupported.

comparison.note: Heterogeneous cells are not independent trials or a replication-success probability.

sensitivity.scope: All six leave-one-country-out M1 fits, unchanged original five dummy slopes; sample-influence check, not M2/M3 or full specification robustness.
